title: FAITHFULNESS: emergencyTransfer breaks story-008 HIGH-5's promise of a safe pauseWithdraw exit after a drain - post-drain pauseWithdraw reverts for everyone
description: story-008 HIGH-5 advertises an on-chain guarantee that users can 'safely exit via pauseWithdraw' after an emergency action. emergencyTransfer drains all balances and _pause()s (L214-227); any post-drain pauseWithdraw (L257 safeTransfer) reverts for lack of balance. The advertised on-chain recovery promise therefore does NOT hold - a Law-2 behavioural deviation from the story.
impact: No direct protocol value loss in the intended flow: the emergencyTransfer drain is owner-trusted and redistribution is intended off-chain (story-049). The deviation is purely that the story-008 HIGH-5 on-chain recovery guarantee is unmet. Honest severity Low (faithfulness). The security manifestation of the same mechanism is carried by C-01 (ledger C-02).
attackPath: 1. Story-008 HIGH-5 states users retain a safe pauseWithdraw exit after emergency action.
3. Any post-drain pauseWithdraw (L257 safeTransfer) reverts for lack of balance -> the advertised on-chain recovery promise is unmet.
recommendation: Reconcile spec and code: either (a) update story-008 HIGH-5 to state that recovery after emergencyTransfer is off-chain (story-049) and there is no on-chain pauseWithdraw exit post-drain, or (b) make emergencyTransfer leave a recoverable on-chain path (e.g. do not drain to zero, or zero accounting so pauseWithdraw degrades gracefully).
corroboratingSources: cross-ref C-01 / ledger C-02 (security manifestation of the same mechanism)

tier3Verification.detail: Spec-conformance deviation, surfaced regardless of exploit likelihood per Law 2. Distinct rootCauseClass (faithfulness-deviation) => distinct fingerprint from C-01/C-02.
